Get new record data with webhooks | Airtable Community
Discord Embed Limits Cheat Sheet (Characters, Fields & Total Payload) — Discord Webhook

notes: Pagination: Use baseTransactionNumber to track processed payloads; incrementally fetch new payloads by comparing baseTransactionNumber values.
To get full record data, you must subsequently call GET /v0/{baseId}/{tableNameOrId}/{recordId} for each recordId in payloads[].changedTablesById[tableId].recordIds.
Webhook payloads expire after 7 days; ensure frequent polling to avoid data loss.
The payload does not include field values directly; you must fetch the record via the Airtable REST API to obtain the 'fields' object.

embeds.title: New Record Created
embeds.description: A new record has been added to the table.

notes: The webhook URL includes the token as part of the path; no additional auth headers are needed.
At least one of 'content', 'embeds', 'components', 'file', or 'poll' must be provided.
Embeds are limited to 10 per message and total embed text (title, description, field names/values, footer.text, author.name) must not exceed 6000 characters.
Content is limited to 2000 characters (4000 with Discord Nitro).
Timestamp must be an ISO 8601 string.
No pagination is applicable for this endpoint as it is a fire-and-forget message send.
